_meta.fit: Nelder-Mead on per-face centroid (x,y) and sqrt(area) for every 2nd frame (90 frames, 5 face colours), CSS-equivalent model: rotateY(spin) then rotateX(-tilt), translate to centre + bob, perspective P with origin (ox, oy). Centroid/area RMS 0.23 px, max 0.96 px.
_meta.corner_residuals: Model (rounded values below) vs mask-extracted face corners at frames 0,10,22,30,45,60,68,90,112,135,150,165 (128 corners): mean 1.80 px, median 1.61 px, p90 3.40 px, max 5.14 px. Extraction is biased inward at acute corners by antialiasing, so these are upper bounds.
_meta.render_check: Chromium headless render vs reference at 13 times (0..5.967 s): per-face mask IoU mean 0.968 (0.941-0.987), centroid offsets <= 1.0 px, full-frame MAE 0.68-0.76 /255.
